literal_meaning: বাপ (পিতা) - ঠাকুর (প্রভু বা ব্রাহ্মণের সম্মানসূচক উপাধি)
figurative_meaning_en: A respectful form of address used for Brahmins
example_sentences_in_bangla: গ্রামের পুরোহিতকে বাপ-ঠাকুর বলে সম্মান করা হয়।
তিনি এত বিজ্ঞ যে সকলে তাঁকে বাপ-ঠাকুর বলে ডাকেন।
example_sentences_in_english: The village priest is addressed as Baba-Thakur out of respect.
He is so wise that everyone calls him Baba-Thakur.
history: This term originates from traditional Bengali Hindu society where Brahmins held esteemed positions as priests and scholars, used to denote paternal and divine respect.
note: Primarily used in older or rural contexts; less common in modern urban settings due to evolving social norms.
